title: Device catalog V2
description: Shared catalog shape. Spaces are instance data: roomId references configuration.rooms or is null while unassigned. Persisted configuration constrains state to unknown; live state uses a separate schema.

roomId.$comment: Instance-defined space ID; its SVG zone is room-${roomId}. V1's closed vocabulary lives in schemas/v1/.

control.$comment: Named by how it is operated. Steps: button 1, cycle 2-4, updown 2 (up, down), select 2-8, slider none (adjusts entityId's own value, or the device entity's) or 2-12 stops.

size.$comment: Size of the symbol on the plan; m when absent.

archetype.$comment: Optional presentation override; inferred without changing the stored document when absent.

show.$comment: Body content; value for meters and icon for other archetypes when absent.

category.$comment: What the person chose (D21). Decides the archetype; inferred from archetype or kind when absent.

pinned.$comment: Controls of bindings.controls shown next to the symbol, in this order.

values.$comment: Plan 0.12 #92: readings shown on the symbol, in order; each reading once (semantic check).

standalone.$comment: Plan 0.12 #95: a drawing or shortcut that needs no device link.

indicators.$comment: Plan 0.13: visual marks on the symbol from one reading; one of each type (semantic check).

readings.$comment: Additional readings exclude the principal (semantic validation); registry membership is checked live without rejecting older plans.

tap.$comment: Control (button or cycle) a tap on the symbol runs; null opens the panel. Absent: primaryAction, as before.

gestureChoice.$comment: Plan 0.12 #97: a short menu of 2 to 4 gestures.

$comment: Semantic validation must additionally reject duplicate device IDs, roomId values not declared in configuration.rooms, non-finite numbers in in-memory input, unsafe object keys, invalid or unresolved HA references and unsafe icon content. No real household data belongs in the public repository.
